hero.title: From the field to the market, all in one place
hero.subtitle: AgriLink brings farmers, agricultural officers and buyers together — report crop problems, get expert advice and sell your harvest directly.

farmer.title: Farmers
farmer.description: Keep track of your farms, fields and crops, report crop problems with photos, get advice from officers and list your harvest for sale.

officer.title: Agricultural officers
officer.description: Review the problems farmers in your area report, send advisories and approve new farmer registrations.
officer.note: Officer accounts are created by an administrator.

buyer.title: Buyers
buyer.description: Browse fresh harvests from across the island and send purchase requests straight to the farmer.

marketplace.title: Fresh on the marketplace
marketplace.subtitle: Harvests farmers have listed recently.
marketplace.empty: No harvests are listed right now. Check back soon.
marketplace.error: The marketplace couldn't be loaded right now.

register.title: Register
register.description: Sign up as a farmer or a buyer in a few minutes.

approval.title: Get approved
approval.description: An officer checks your details so everyone on AgriLink is genuine.

setUp.title: Add your farm or browse
setUp.description: Farmers add their farms and crops; buyers start browsing harvests.

connect.title: Connect and trade
connect.description: Get advice on crop problems and buy or sell directly.

footer.tagline: Connecting Sri Lankan farmers, officers and buyers.
